name: GL_PURGE_DATA_TO_PURGE
description: This table stores the details of what is going to be purged after the purge action for specific criteria is selected, but before the purge process is submitted. These details are stored only when the retention location for the archived data is Oracle Cloud ERP.

columns.name: PURGE_RUN_ID
columns.description: Purge run identifier for this row.

columns.name: BUSINESS_OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Business object for which the archived data is going to be purged. Some valid values are ORA_GL_JOURNALS for General Ledger journals and ORA_GL_BALANCES for General Ledger balances.

columns.name: CALENDAR_ID
columns.description: Accounting calendar identifier associated with the archived data that is going to be purged.

columns.name: PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Accounting calendar name associated with the archived data that is going to be purged.

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Period type for the accounting calendar associated with the archived data that is going to be purged.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier for which the archived data is going to be purged. Can be a primary ledger, secondary ledger, or reporting currency. A value of -99 indicates this row applies to all ledgers.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity for which archive and purge is being done. -99 in cases where this row is across legal entities.

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: First period that is going to be purged for this combination of business object, calendar, ledger (if applicable), and legal entity (if applicable).

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Period year of the first period that is going to be purged for this combination of business object, calendar, ledger (if applicable), and legal entity (if applicable).

columns.name: FROM_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period number of the first period that is going to be purged for this combination of business object, calendar, ledger (if applicable), and legal entity (if applicable).

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Last period that is going to be purged for this combination of business object, calendar, ledger (if applicable), and legal entity (if applicable).

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Period year of the last period that is going to be purged for this combination of business object, calendar, ledger (if applicable), and legal entity (if applicable).

columns.name: TO_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Period number of the last period that is going to be purged for this combination of business object, calendar, ledger (if applicable), and legal entity (if applicable).

columns.name: PURGE_DATE
columns.description: Date through which periods are being purged for this combination of business object, calendar, ledger (if applicable), and legal entity (if applicable).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Balancing segment value associated with the specified retention period. A value of -99 indicates all balancing segment values.
